description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 10<sup>3</sup>, with tick labels at 10<sup>0</sup>, 10<sup>1</sup>, 10<sup>2</sup>, and 10<sup>3</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80. A black line with circular markers, representing “Base”, begins at approximately (1, 60) and increases to approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 66). A pink line with diamond markers, representing “MEND”, begins at approximately (1, 70) and increases to approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 73). A blue line with triangular markers, representing “FT”, begins at approximately (1, 63) and increases to approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 68). A magenta line with square markers, representing “MEMIT”, begins at approximately (1, 71) and increases to approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 75). A red line with downward-pointing triangular markers, representing “IKE”, begins at approximately (1, 65) and increases to approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 70). A green line with square markers, representing “ROME”, begins at approximately (1, 72) and increases to approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 76).
